name: Sunday Times cryptic crossword, Penguin book 1 No 61

clue.text: Far from conservative in approach, yet didn’t interfere with theatrical scenery
Take a journey — and do return with photographic equip- ment
It may be cure, song or sponge!
Issue not incomplete when coming out
A doctor showed the way, though quite muddle-headed
Chaps break blade — but can be repaired!
Bad manners from a harsh head
Not too fast, but very stylishly up-to-date — muse on that!
About to press for control
If acar crashed, could you arrive here?
Dishevelled Danish army doctor comes in to deliver a rebuke
Open city in Africa?
Such extravagant remorse might give you a thrill
It often keeps a union together
Put your best suit to good use, quite probably
Mishap the distraught editor encountered with Lady Love?
Action word of the modern era or one that qualifies it ?
The cobbler working at the end of the run?
Advance order for administrative areas of the city
Twisted and hurt
However small, they should be worth their weight in gold
Since he doesn’t start, he may save better money!
Ican roam all over the place with such sustenance
Expressed willingness to go away with the wild deer
A girl and I on an errand
‘Clothed in white —, mystic, wonderful’ (Tennyson: The Passing of Arthur)
Does she fall in the fire needlessly ?
